data.why: App ships bundled DEA/GSEA CSVs it reads by default; sidebar uploaders accept the same files (or the 3-sample variant) to test re-upload.

goals: Load the default DEA/GSEA results and see the baseline Kaplan-Meier curves, log-rank p-value and Cox PH forest plot for the Immune Risk Score
Tune the padj and |log2FC| cut-offs to see how the set of significant and immune DEGs, and the resulting IRS hazard ratio, change
Adjust GSEA FDR cut-off to change which negatively enriched terms set the simulated effect size and watch the survival separation shift
Vary cohort size, follow-up time and random seed to check how stable the log-rank p-value and Cox hazard ratio are across simulated cohorts
Inspect the volcano plot and immune DEG table to understand which genes feed the IRS
Upload a different DEA/GSEA CSV pair (e.g. DEA_results_3_samples.csv) and confirm the app errors clearly when required columns or significant hits are missing

review.summary: The tree captures what the tool is for: building an immune score from DEA/GSEA results, then testing how sensitive simulated survival separation is to cut-offs and simulation settings. Its screens hold up on inspection, but before filing, the baseline reading needs its own phase, carried-over settings must be stated so the numbers can be replayed, the widget-minimum claim needs correcting, and the README's reporting and negative-control steps should be added.
